copy.description:
A printable caregiver organizer to keep key care details in one place: contacts, medications as prescribed, appointments, daily notes and the papers that matter, ready to hand to family or a respite helper.

How this was made: I used AI tools to help draft the page text and structure of this binder, and to help create the layout and listing mockup images. I reviewed and edited all of it before listing. This is an organizer, not medical, legal or financial advice. No part of it has been reviewed by a medical or legal professional.

WHAT'S INSIDE (35 pages, 9 sections)
- Care Snapshot: about the person you care for, daily routine and preferences
- Care Team & Contacts: emergency contacts and quick info, providers, pharmacy and services, family and neighbors
- Medications: a list copied exactly from the label, a change record, a refill tracker and a daily checklist
- Appointments: tracker, visit notes, a page of questions to ask, hospital and urgent visit record
- Daily Care: a care log, a weekly summary and a record of changes noticed, in your own words
- Documents Index: where insurance, legal and household papers are kept (never the numbers)
- Hand-Off: sheets for family or respite helpers, and shift handover notes
- Family Task-Sharing: a task grid, a weekly coverage calendar and meeting notes
- Caregiver Self-Care: a weekly check-in and a breaks plan
Plus a cover, a how-to-use page and a binder review log.

FORMAT
- Digital download: 2 PDF files, US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4. Nothing is shipped.
- Print at home or at a print shop and fill it in by hand.
- Reprint as needed: the medication checklist, visit notes, care log, weekly summary, handover notes, coverage calendar and check-in pages.

PLEASE NOTE
- Once completed, this binder contains private health information. Please store it securely.
- An information organizer only. Not medical, legal or financial advice. Consult licensed professionals. In an emergency, call local emergency services.
- For personal use. Please don't resell or share the files.
